'按任意鍵開始 / ENTER PRESS ANY KEY' start prompt

evidence.note: The main-menu nav (Story/Trials/Records/Controls) is in the DOM but hidden in the capture. It is a persistent game main menu, not a transient list opened from a trigger.
The controls reference table exists only in the hidden DOM and is not visible in the capture.
The Controls panel is hidden in the capture, so no dialog is shown.
The live page shows a seal-and-ring loading spinner first, but the capture is past loading.

structure.layout: single full-viewport game title screen: a WebGL canvas fills the viewport, with an HTML overlay of the logo, start prompt and floating character labels on the left and middle

aesthetics.typography: Xingkai SC (brush calligraphy) for the 250px 無雙 logo and section headings; Kaiti SC for the Chinese menu/prompt text and name plates; Avenir Next, widely letter-spaced and uppercase, for the English subtitles ('VOXEL MUSOU', 'PRESS ANY KEY', name romanizations)
aesthetics.typeScale: Extreme contrast: the 250px gold-gradient calligraphy logo vs a ~43-50px Kaiti prompt vs 15-19px tracked caps. A bilingual pairing (Chinese large, English small beneath) repeats throughout.

notes: Game title screen in the console style. The capture shows the 'press any key' attract state. The menu (劇情模式 Story, 演武試煉 Trials, 戰績 Records, 操作說明 Controls) with a red diamond cursor and gold brush-stroke highlight, plus a full controls table (keyboard and gamepad glyphs), exist in the DOM but are hidden until a key is pressed. A footer shows controller hints (↑↓ Select, Enter/A Confirm). Distinctive touches: red seal stamps (三國, 常山, 老將), vertical calligraphy name plates floating next to the 3D voxel characters, a gold gradient logo with a dark drop shadow, a keycap-outlined 'ENTER' chip, a thin gold rule after the subtitle, and a warm dusk light with embers. Few codebook patterns apply to a game title screen.
